sections.content_text: Section 111 - Deduction from Compensation for Acquisition of Property A person liable to pay any compensation to the owner of an immovable property for the acquisition thereof, shall deduct tax at the following rate while paying the compensation; (a) 6% (six percent) of the total amount received as compensation if any immovable property is situated in a city corporation, municipality or cantonment board area; (b) 3% (three percent) of the total amount received compensation if any immovable property is situated outside the City Corporation, Municipality or Cantonment Board area.

clauses.text: (a) 6% (six percent) of the total amount received as compensation if any immovable property is situated in a city corporation, municipality or cantonment board area;
(b) 3% (three percent) of the total amount received compensation if any immovable property is situated outside the City Corporation, Municipality or Cantonment Board area.
